question: Veteran Kathak Dancer Aditi Mangaldas bagged the _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahari Award 2022**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Veteran Kathak dancer Aditi Mangaldas was honored with the **Mahari Award 2022**.
 
• The Mahari Award is a prestigious recognition in the field of classical dance, named after the devadasis of the Jagannath Temple in Puri, who were known as Maharis.
